data.description: A hungry flesh leaves behind a trail of slime that acts as a grease spell (DC %1). Any living creature that touches this slime with bare flesh must succeed at a Fortitude save (with a +4 bonus) or contract tumor infestation. The slime dries up after 1 minute.
data.name: Slime Trail
